name: @hl-bos/dispatch-match
description: DispatchOS Match — the backhaul load-matching engine. Filters every (truck, load) pair on hard constraints (equipment vs commodity, weight and volume, timing, radius), then ranks what survives by projected contribution and revenue per mile with a visible, adjustable formula. Equipment-agnostic and tenant-scoped so the same engine serves any fleet. Pure and deterministic — no network, no map API, no secrets.
